# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Organize the records in a chronological order.
3. Identify all the issues and areas of concern.
4. Write out a detailed description of each issue.
5. Include specific location of each problem within the site.
6. Include photos or diagrams to mark problematic areas.
7. Cite any relevant regulations or standards that are violated.
8. Outline the potential risks or consequences associated with each issue.
9. Create actionable recommendations for each identified issue.
10. Assign responsibility and a timeline for the implementation of the recommendations.
11. Add an executive summary at the beginning of the document.
12. Use clear and neutral language throughout the document.
13. Include a section for tracking progress on corrective actions.
